permit_authority.notes: Maine's Uniform Building and Energy Code (MUBEC) is mandatory statewide for municipalities with more than 4,000 residents (smaller towns may opt out of enforcement but cannot substitute a different building code) — a genuinely uniform statewide baseline, though enforcement is local. South Portland's own Code Enforcement division is the local AHJ. State law requires municipalities to exclusively employ code enforcement officers certified by Maine's Department of Economic and Community Development.

Maine's net metering program is branded 'Net Energy Billing' and is administered under Maine PUC rules (Chapter 313 for net energy billing, Chapter 324 for the Interconnection Agreement); customers must file both applications with CMP before service begins.
